All 16 checkouts verified at the pinned commits. The contract is the **SSR/hydration snapshot agreement rule**: what a subscription hook hands back when there is no live store/DOM to read from (`getServerSnapshot` / `isServer` / initial-state fallback), and the requirement that this value equals what the first client (hydrating) render computes. Violations show as a one-frame flicker (value corrected in an effect after paint) or, where no server snapshot is supplied at all, React's hard "Missing getServerSnapshot… will fall back to client rendering" error and a dead subtree (found in `db`'s `useLiveQuery` and tldraw's `TldrawEditor`).
